children: India’s primary market is set for a busy week, with four initial public offerings (IPOs) scheduled to open for subscription from 26 October. The upcoming issues include M K Sons Fine Jewels, SFC Environmental Technologies, BLS Polymers and EAAA India Alternatives, according to information available on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) website and the companies’ offer documents.

EAAA India Alternatives, an arm of Edelweiss Financial Services, will open its IPO for subscription on 26 October and close on 28 October. Anchor investor bidding is scheduled for 23 October, according to the company’s red herring prospectus (RHP).

The company aims to raise Rs 1,200 crore through the issue, which comprises entirely an OFS by the Edelweiss Group. No fresh shares will be issued, meaning the proceeds will go to the selling shareholder rather than the company.

SFC Environmental Technologies will open its IPO on 27 October, with the issue closing on 29 October. The offering comprises a fresh issue of 45.45 lakh shares and an OFS of 1.57 crore shares. The price band has been fixed at Rs 313 to Rs 330 per share.

BLS Polymers will launch its IPO on 27 October, with the subscription window closing on 29 October. The issue comprises a fresh issuance of 1.70 crore shares, through which the company aims to raise Rs 255 crore.

The price band is set at Rs 142 to Rs 150 per share. According to the RHP, the company plans to utilise Rs 77.56 crore from the proceeds to expand its manufacturing facility and increase production capacity for certain existing products.

M K Sons Fine Jewels will open its IPO on 28 October and close on 30 October. The issue comprises a fresh issuance of 1.36 crore shares and an OFS of 34 lakh shares. The price band is set at Rs 153 to Rs 162 per share. Aryaman Financial Services is the book-running lead manager, while Bigshare Services is the registrar to the issue.
